grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is ordinary home food: chicken, vegetables, stock, crème fraîche and Dijon mustard.

supermarket.reason: Drumsticks, leeks, mushrooms, kale, potatoes and crème fraîche are everyday Tesco items at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a lidded casserole and simple browning and simmering.

works.reason: Eight drumsticks, 600g potatoes and 500ml stock simmered for 35 minutes makes a properly cooked, well-sauced casserole for four.

honest_times.reason: The 20 minutes prep plus 45 minutes cook comes to over an hour, which is far past the quick weeknight pace asked for.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the thyme, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hearty casserole suits mid-January, and 400g of mushrooms makes them a main component rather than a garnish, though chicken leads the title.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are plain, clear British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling one-pot meal of chicken, potatoes and plenty of vegetables that a family would happily eat again.
